scope: Two marketed acquisition expressions only. Cohort research is not a separately passing admission funnel.

cases.subject: Eve Suite advertised 680 sqft one-bay furnished compact at RM370000
cases.reference_status: Observed cohort context supported; subject normalised interval unknown
cases.new_evidence: Recent size-filtered publisher-reported transactions; lower dates/prices also displayed on another portal, not independent lineage.
cases.remaining_decision_changing: Whether the marketed 680 sqft/bay/package fits the 689 sqft sale cohort without a material adjustment, and whether the dated observations remain a usable present reference. Dispersion is not itself a demonstrated bound on these adjustments.
cases.permitted_now: Use the observed envelope to challenge an obvious-undervaluation narrative and rank further compact-product research. Compare conditional financing and retention economics.
not_required_for_this_price_research: Paid tenancy as a universal G0 document
cases.reopen_when: Public plan/rights/transaction particulars support subject-cohort matching and a justified interval, or contrary current evidence changes the band; no fixed transaction count required.

cases.subject: Maxim Residences advertised 825 sqft two-bed one-bay partly furnished at RM380000
cases.reference_status: Historical near-size context supported; present normalised interval unknown
cases.new_evidence: Size-filtered 2023-24 sale records and one visible 2025 near-size transaction.
cases.remaining_decision_changing: Current 825/829 sqft clearing support plus size/condition/rights normalisation. Old RM440000 is not a present upper bound.
cases.permitted_now: Retain two-bedroom challenger and conditional financial comparison; no premium from additional bedroom alone.
cases.reopen_when: A public current matched transaction or other defensible triangulation supports timing and product normalisation.

outcome.historical_138_count: Preserved snapshot; not freshly revalidated for all cases.

miss.description: Prior comparable work relied too heavily on mixed portal summaries. Public filtered transaction rows were available in this investigation and materially improve cohort context. Record the omission; do not relabel it as a proven missed profitable deal.

divergence.reason: Privacy utility and negative full-cost carry concern different propositions and can coexist. No validated expectation of a resale premium is inferred from the user's product preference.
divergence.hypothesis: Privacy-focused demand could improve retention enough to offset the extra turnover drag.
divergence.confirming: Comparable achieved whole-unit rent with documented retention and collections, without offsetting fee/fit-out burden.
divergence.falsifying: Frequent replacement, concessions, arrears or unpriced cost eliminates the modelled retention improvement.

competing_explanations.data_limitation: Advertised rent and publisher sale coverage may misrepresent collection and comparable units.
competing_explanations.judgment_bias: Preferred-product narrative may lead the analyst to assume retention and appreciation.
competing_explanations.omitted_variable: Bay, tenant task, management, condition and fit-out may explain performance differences.
competing_explanations.structural_change: Future demand/supply changes may alter rent or exit; no uplift adopted without evidence.
